title: PERF-001: Add response validation to paginated endpoints
description: getAgents and getJobs endpoints make requests but don't validate the response structure using Zod schemas like other endpoints. If the API contract changes, errors won't be caught early. Adding response validation ensures type safety and early error detection.

context.issue: Inconsistent validation pattern; some endpoints validated, others not

acceptance_criteria: Both functions validate response structure before returning
Validation matches pattern used in getGroups and login
Type hints are correct for validated responses
API contract changes are caught at runtime
Schemas AgentListSchema and JobListSchema are imported correctly

implementation_notes.schemas_location: Schemas should exist in dashboard/src/schemas/agents.ts and dashboard/src/schemas/jobs.ts
implementation_notes.import_check: Verify AgentListSchema and JobListSchema are imported at top of api.ts
implementation_notes.validation_function: validateResponse(path, schema, response) validates response matches schema

unit_test: Mock API response with valid schema
Verify validateResponse is called with correct arguments
Mock API response with invalid schema
Verify error is thrown on schema validation failure
integration_test: Call getAgents() with valid API response
Verify correct data structure is returned
Call with invalid response and verify error is thrown
Check error message is helpful for debugging
manual_test: Load Agents page and verify agents list displays
Check browser DevTools Network tab for /api/agents request
Verify response is validated (use breakpoint in validateResponse)
Try with network throttling to ensure validation doesn't timeout

rollback_plan: git revert <commit-hash> — adds validation, safe to revert if schemas don't exist
notes: This ensures getAgents and getJobs follow the same validation pattern as getGroups and login. If schemas don't exist, they should be created or imported from appropriate locations. Validation is critical for catching API contract violations early.
